configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Settings shared by every preset. Not selectable directly.

configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build inside the project Docker image. GoogleTest is fetched and built from source; nothing is taken from /opt.

configurePresets.name: workstation
configurePresets.description: Release build outside the image. Same dependencies as `default` -- only the build directory differs, so the two can coexist.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build using Ninja and Clang

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer build for host code memory error detection -- CXX units and the host side of every .cu (Debug + ASAN, separate build-asan/ dir)

configurePresets.name: compute-sanitizer
configurePresets.description: Debug CUDA build whose ctest entries each run under NVIDIA compute-sanitizer (CALAMAN_COMPUTE_SANITIZER_TOOL, default memcheck; reconfigure with -D to switch tool without a rebuild). CUDA only: AMD has no counterpart, and a HIP configure refuses the option.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Debug build with clang source-based coverage for host (CXX) code. Drive it through devtools/coverage.sh, which runs ctest and post-processes with llvm-profdata/llvm-cov.

configurePresets.name: hip
configurePresets.description: Release build against the ROCm/HIP backend instead of CUDA. Needs ROCm, not the CUDA toolkit.

configurePresets.name: hip-asan
configurePresets.description: The asan preset against ROCm/HIP: Debug + AddressSanitizer on host code (CXX units and the host side of every .cu), device code left uninstrumented.

configurePresets.name: compile-time
configurePresets.description: Configures only the compile-time tests: no GoogleTest fetch, no runtime test targets, no GPU needed.

configurePresets.name: ci-cuda
configurePresets.description: The CUDA half of CI: the whole tree built, GoogleTest and every runtime binary included, with the architecture PINNED so configure never queries a driver. Its test preset excludes the `gpu` label, which leaves a COMPILE-AND-LINK answer plus whatever CPU-only tests exist. It does not test GPU behaviour; nothing without a card can.

configurePresets.name: ci-hip
configurePresets.description: The HIP half of CI, deliberately the same shape as ci-cuda: the whole tree through clang's -x hip front end, runtime test binaries included, then the same `-LE gpu` selection. Compiling the test sources is the point -- clang is the stricter front end, and nvcc waves through code it rejects. Note this also compiles WarpWraps for HIP, which is where a portability break in the dependency's device code would surface.

configurePresets.name: ci-asan
configurePresets.description: The asan preset with ci-cuda's pinned architecture, so it configures without a driver: Debug + AddressSanitizer on host code (CXX units and the host side of every .cu), the whole tree built. Its test preset excludes the `gpu` label, so what runs is the host-only suites plus the host ASan/LSan canaries -- and the canaries are what prove ASan is on. It checks no device code.
